"import csv

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

CSV_PATH = "load_02.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.pptx"


def read_rows(path):
    """Read the CSV and return a list of dict rows with stripped strings."""
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
        if reader.fieldnames:
            reader.fieldnames = [fn.strip() for fn in reader.fieldnames]
        rows = []
        for raw in reader:
            row = {(k or "").strip(): (v or "").strip() for k, v in raw.items() if k}
            if not any(row.values()):
                continue  # skip blank lines
            rows.append(row)
    required = {"case", "load_factor", "cycles"}
    if rows:
        missing = required - set(rows[0].keys())
        if missing:
            raise ValueError("CSV missing required columns: {}".format(sorted(missing)))
    return rows


def style_run(run, size, bold=False):
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.name = "Calibri"


def fill_cell(cell, text, size, bold=False):
    cell.text = str(text)
    cell.margin_top = Inches(0.01)
    cell.margin_bottom = Inches(0.01)
    cell.margin_left = Inches(0.06)
    cell.margin_right = Inches(0.06)
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for r in p.runs:
            style_run(r, size, bold)


def add_bullet(paragraph, char="\u2022"):
    """Apply a bullet glyph via XML so extracted text stays clean."""
    pPr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    for tag in ("a:buNone", "a:buChar", "a:buAutoNum"):
        for el in pPr.findall(qn(tag)):
            pPr.remove(el)
    bu = pPr.makeelement(qn("a:buChar"), {"char": char})
    pPr.append(bu)


def add_bulleted_box(slide, lines, left, top, width, height, size=20):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(left), Inches(top), Inches(width), Inches(height))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = line
        style_run(run, size)
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        add_bullet(p)
    return box


def main():
    rows = read_rows(CSV_PATH)

    # ---- compute all numeric claims from the input data ----
    loads = [float(r["load_factor"]) for r in rows]
    cycles = [int(float(r["cycles"])) for r in rows]

    n = len(rows)
    load_max = max(loads)
    load_mean = sum(loads) / n
    total_cycles = sum(cycles)

    summary_lines = [
        "N cases = {}".format(n),
        "load max = {:.2f}".format(load_max),
        "load mean = {:.2f}".format(load_mean),
        "total cycles = {}".format(total_cycles),
    ]

    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

    # ---- Slide 1: Title ----
    s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    s1.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
    s1.placeholders[1].text = "Load case data review \u2014 load_02.csv"

    # ---- Slide 2: Data table (header row + one row per record) ----
    s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
    s2.shapes.title.text = "Data"
    headers = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]
    n_rows = len(rows) + 1
    row_h = 0.24 if n_rows <= 26 else 0.18
    gfx = s2.shapes.add_table(
        n_rows, 3, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.35), Inches(6.6), Inches(row_h * n_rows)
    )
    table = gfx.table
    for j, w in enumerate((Inches(2.0), Inches(2.4), Inches(2.2))):
        table.columns[j].width = w
    for i in range(n_rows):
        table.rows[i].height = Inches(row_h)
    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
        fill_cell(table.cell(0, j), h, 10, bold=True)
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        fill_cell(table.cell(i, 0), r["case"], 9)
        fill_cell(table.cell(i, 1), r["load_factor"], 9)
        fill_cell(table.cell(i, 2), r["cycles"], 9)

    # ---- Slide 3: Summary (exact computed numbers) ----
    s3 = prs.slides.add_sli"
